# Cncf Arcfra Kubernetes Engine Reviewer

Review Arcfra Kubernetes Engine using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. Arcfra Kubernetes Engine (AKE) is the Kubernetes service of Arcfra Enterprise Cloud Platform (AECP). It helps enterprises automate the complete production-ready Kubernetes infrastructure, simplifying deployment, management, and usage with an out-of-the-box experience.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
